description: Start email verification before showing a customer's private data (past orders, reorder, saved address, email order-status). Sends a 6-digit code to the email. Returns a verificationId. Then ask the customer for the code and call vivid_identity_verify. Use this whenever a customer asks to see 'my orders', 'reorder', or 'status by email' and you don't already have a valid identity token.
name: vivid_identity_start
